creators.name: Jiahe Li
creators.bio: Designer-researcher and first author of Being Stone, a VR study of nonhuman embodiment presented at DIS 2026 with Hao Zhu, Yian Tang, Martijn ten Bhömer and Aven-Le Zhou.
creators.why: Being Stone is one of the very few realised XR works that asks a participant to become a rock rather than look at one.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，DIS 2026 论文《Being Stone》的第一作者，合作者为 Hao Zhu、Yian Tang、Martijn ten Bhömer 与 Aven-Le Zhou。
creators.why_zh: 《Being Stone》是极少数已实现的 XR 作品之一，它让参与者成为一块石头，而不是观看石头。

creators.name: Aven-Le Zhou
creators.bio: Designer and researcher working on AI, robotics and more-than-human interaction; senior author of Being Stone (DIS 2026).
creators.why: Supervised Being Stone, a VR prototype that frames becoming a stone as a design problem for nonhuman embodiment.
creators.role_zh: 关注超越人类交互的设计研究者
creators.bio_zh: 从事人工智能、机器人与超越人类交互的设计师和研究者，DIS 2026 论文《Being Stone》的通讯作者。
creators.why_zh: 指导了《Being Stone》：这件 VR 原型把“成为一块石头”当作非人类具身的设计问题来处理。

creators.name: Martijn ten Bhömer
creators.role: Designer and researcher in wearables and embodied interaction
creators.bio: Dutch design researcher working on smart textiles, wearables and embodied interaction; co-author of Being Stone.
creators.why: Co-developed the sensor-equipped carved stone that links the physical rock to the participant's stone body in VR.
creators.role_zh: 研究可穿戴与具身交互的设计师和研究者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰设计研究者，研究智能纺织品、可穿戴设备与具身交互，《Being Stone》合著者。
creators.why_zh: 参与开发了装有传感器的雕刻石头，把实体岩石与参与者在 VR 中的石头身体连在一起。

creators.name: Nathalie Delprat
creators.bio: Researcher at LIMSI-CNRS (Université Paris-Sud) who built the RêvA cloud-avatar system with motion capture and particle simulation in the lab's EVE immersive room.
creators.why: Her cloud-avatar turns the participant's own tracked body into cumulus, stratus or cirrus, an early realised case of becoming weather.
creators.role_zh: 物理学者与艺术—科学研究者
creators.bio_zh: LIMSI-CNRS（巴黎南大学）研究者，在实验室的 EVE 沉浸空间里用动作捕捉与粒子模拟搭建了 RêvA 云化身系统。
creators.why_zh: 她的云化身把参与者被追踪的身体变成积云、层云或卷云，是“成为天气”的早期实现案例。

creators.name: New Jersey Governor's School of Engineering and Technology
creators.role: Summer research programme for high-school students, Rutgers University
creators.bio: Rutgers-hosted summer programme where student teams build engineering research projects; the 2017 SplashSim team was Nicole Chin, Aakash Gupte, John Nguyen, Sabrina Sukhin and Grace Wang, mentored by Joe Mirizio.
creators.why: SplashSim puts the user inside the water cycle as a single droplet, a rare first-person water becoming in VR education.
creators.role_zh: 罗格斯大学面向高中生的暑期科研项目
creators.based_zh: 美国新泽西州新不伦瑞克
creators.bio_zh: 由罗格斯大学主办的暑期项目，学生团队完成工程研究课题；2017 年 SplashSim 团队成员为 Nicole Chin、Aakash Gupte、John Nguyen、Sabrina Sukhin 与 Grace Wang，导师 Joe Mirizio。
creators.why_zh: SplashSim 让用户以一滴水的身份进入水循环，是 VR 教育中少见的第一人称“成为水”的作品。

creators.name: Jason Sperske
creators.bio: Developer who published The Wind, a small open-source WebXR piece, on GitHub in 2026.
creators.why: The Wind is one of the only realised XR works in which the player is a gust of wind rather than a body moving through it.
creators.bio_zh: 开发者，2026 年在 GitHub 上发布了开源 WebXR 小品《The Wind》。
creators.why_zh: 《The Wind》是极少数已实现、让玩家本身就是一阵风（而不是在风中移动的身体）的 XR 作品之一。

creators.name: micha cárdenas
creators.role: Artist, performer and scholar of trans and digital media
creators.bio: Artist and professor at UC Santa Cruz whose work joins trans theory, mixed reality and wearable technology; author of Poetic Operations.
creators.why: Becoming Dragon used a head-mounted display and motion capture to live 365 hours as a dragon, the reference case for becoming a mythical creature through XR.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、表演者与跨性别及数字媒体学者
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校的艺术家与教授，作品把跨性别理论、混合现实与可穿戴技术结合在一起，著有《Poetic Operations》。
creators.why_zh: 《Becoming Dragon》用头显和动作捕捉以龙的身份生活了 365 小时，是通过 XR 成为神话生物的参照案例。

creators.name: Zoink
creators.bio: Swedish studio behind Stick It to the Man!, Fe and the PlayStation VR game Ghost Giant.
creators.why: Ghost Giant casts the player as a huge, invisible spirit whose scale and hands are the whole interface.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典工作室，作品有《Stick It to the Man!》《Fe》以及 PlayStation VR 游戏《Ghost Giant》。
creators.why_zh: 《Ghost Giant》让玩家扮演一个巨大而隐形的幽灵，它的体型和双手就是全部的交互方式。

creators.name: Shogo Fukushima
creators.bio: Researcher and first author of NariTan (2024) with Keigo Sakamoto and Yugo Nakamura, a VR system for vocabulary learning through a dragon avatar.
creators.why: NariTan is a published study in which the learner embodies a dragon in a headset, one of few documented mythical-creature avatars in HCI.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，2024 年与 Keigo Sakamoto、Yugo Nakamura 共同发表 NariTan：一个通过龙化身学习词汇的 VR 系统。
creators.why_zh: NariTan 是一项已发表的研究，学习者戴上头显化身为龙，是人机交互中少有的有文献记录的神话生物化身。

works.title: Being Stone
works.description: A VR experience in which the participant inhabits the viewpoint of a stone lying in an underwater world, an entity that changes over time but does not act with intention. Participants either handle a real carved stone before entering VR or keep touching it while inside.
works.description_zh: 一件 VR 作品：参与者占据一块躺在水下世界里的石头的视角——它会随时间改变，却不带意图地行动。参与者要么先把玩一块真实的雕刻石头再进入 VR，要么在 VR 中一直触摸它。
works.idea_en: Becoming stone means giving up intention: agency is felt as indirect, distributed and noticed only in hindsight, somewhere between human action and mineral endurance.
works.idea_zh: 成为石头意味着放弃意图：能动性变得间接、分散，只能事后察觉，处在人的行动与矿物的持久之间。
works.method: A custom underwater VR scene is coupled to a carved natural stone fitted with light, proximity, touch and orientation sensors; experience was measured with a Virtual (Stone) Embodiment Questionnaire and interviews.
works.method_zh: 定制的水下 VR 场景与一块雕刻过的天然石头相连，石头装有光线、接近、触摸与姿态传感器；体验通过“虚拟（石头）具身问卷”和访谈来测量。

paper.title: Being Stone: Designing Nonhuman Embodiment in VR

works.title: Cloud-Avatar (RêvA / Walking Clouds)
works.description: In a large immersive projection room the participant's tracked body appears as a cloud that can be switched between cumulus of different densities, stratus and cirrus, and can be blown by wind. Moving changes how the cloud-matter gathers, thins and drifts.
works.description_zh: 在一个大型沉浸式投影空间里，参与者被追踪的身体显示为一团云，可在不同密度的积云、层云与卷云之间切换，还会被风吹动。身体的动作改变云的聚集、稀薄与漂移。
works.idea_en: Becoming a cloud is learning a body without edges: your density, not your outline, is what you feel yourself changing.
works.idea_zh: 成为一朵云，就是学习一具没有边界的身体：你感到改变的是自己的密度，而不是轮廓。
works.method: Real-time motion capture drives a particle generator that renders the body as cloud types inside LIMSI-CNRS's EVE immersive room (stereo projection, CAVE-like).
works.method_zh: 实时动作捕捉驱动粒子生成器，在 LIMSI-CNRS 的 EVE 沉浸空间（立体投影、类似 CAVE）里把身体渲染成不同类型的云。
shown_at: Leonardo/Olats workshop 'Water is in the Air', Marseille 2012

works.title: Star-Stuff: a way for the universe to know itself
works.description: A two-person VR experience in which each immersant's body is redrawn as constellations: stars stream from the heart and orbit the hips as a spiral galaxy that reshapes as they move. The partner can be a co-present friend or a remote stranger.
works.description_zh: 一件双人 VR 作品：每位体验者的身体被重新画成星座——恒星从心口涌出，绕着髋部旋转成一个螺旋星系，随动作改变形状。同伴可以是身边的朋友，也可以是远方的陌生人。
works.idea_en: Taking Sagan literally: your body becomes a small galaxy, and moving together is how two people recognise they are made of the same stars.
works.idea_zh: 把萨根的话当真：你的身体变成一个小星系，一起移动就是两个人认出彼此由同样星辰构成的方式。
works.method: Headset hand tracking maps the hands to constellations and a generated star field to the torso, with networked multi-user presence; released on Meta Quest via Hoame.
works.method_zh: 头显手部追踪把双手映射为星座，躯干周围生成星场，并支持联网多人在场；通过 Hoame 在 Meta Quest 上发布。

paper.title: Star-Stuff: a way for the universe to know itself

works.title: SplashSim
works.description: A mobile VR application in which the user travels through the water cycle as a single water droplet, passing through evaporation, condensation and precipitation.
works.description_zh: 一款手机 VR 应用：用户以一滴水的身份走完水循环，依次经历蒸发、凝结与降水。
works.idea_en: The water cycle told from inside one droplet: changes of state become things that happen to your body.
works.idea_zh: 从一滴水内部讲述水循环：物态变化成了发生在你身上的事。
works.method: Smartphone VR headset with gyroscope head tracking and spatial audio; the droplet's journey is a scripted sequence of scenes (likely built in Unity).
works.method_zh: 智能手机 VR 头显，借助陀螺仪追踪头部并配有空间音频；水滴的旅程是一组预设场景（很可能用 Unity 制作）。
shown_at: IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference 2017

paper.title: Using virtual reality for an immersive experience in the water cycle

works.title: The Wind
works.description: A small WebXR piece in which the player is a gust of wind skimming low over a meadow, dunes and tundra. Hovering over closed buds opens them, and the petals they release make the wind stronger and able to climb.
works.description_zh: 一件小型 WebXR 作品：玩家是一阵风，贴着草地、沙丘和苔原低低掠过。在含苞的花上盘旋能让它绽放，花瓣会让风变强，从而能够爬升。
works.idea_en: Being wind means having no body except what you carry: your strength is the petals you pick up.
works.idea_zh: 成为风，意味着除了你携带的东西之外没有身体：你的力量就是你卷起的花瓣。
works.method: Browser-based three.js WebXR scene playable on Meta Quest, with worlds (terrain, weather, time of day) authored as editable SVG maps.
works.method_zh: 基于浏览器的 three.js WebXR 场景，可在 Meta Quest 上运行；世界（地形、天气、时段）以可编辑的 SVG 地图编写。

works.title: Becoming Dragon
works.description: A 365-hour mixed-reality performance in which the artist lived as a dragon avatar in Second Life, wearing a head-mounted display and seeing the physical world only through a video feed. Audiences watched a stereoscopic projection and heard her voice processed into a dragon's.
works.description_zh: 一场长达 365 小时的混合现实表演：艺术家戴着头显，以龙的化身生活在 Second Life 中，只能通过视频画面看到现实世界。观众观看立体投影，听到她被处理成龙声的嗓音。
works.idea_en: Asks whether a year of 'Second Life Experience' could stand in for the 'Real Life Experience' demanded before gender surgery, and leads to species reassignment: becoming a mythical animal as a way of thinking about transition.
works.idea_zh: 追问一年的“第二人生体验”能否替代变性手术前被要求的“真实生活体验”，并通向“物种重置”：把成为神话动物当作思考过渡的方式。
works.method: Head-mounted display with a camera pass-through, a motion capture system mapping the performer's movements to the Second Life dragon, a Pure Data voice patch and stereoscopic projection for the audience.
works.method_zh: 带摄像头透视的头显、把表演者动作映射到 Second Life 龙身上的动作捕捉系统、Pure Data 变声程序，以及面向观众的立体投影。

paper.title: Becoming Dragon: a mixed reality durational performance in Second Life

works.title: Bodyless
works.description: A VR experience in which the viewer embodies the ghost of a political prisoner who died under Taiwan's martial law, returning from the underworld during Ghost Month. Floating and flying as the spirit, they drift through the artist's childhood memories of the 1970s and into a data-surveilled future.
works.description_zh: 一件 VR 作品：观众化身为一位死于台湾戒严时期的政治犯的鬼魂，在鬼月从阴间返回人间。他们以灵魂的身份漂浮、飞行，穿过艺术家对 1970 年代的童年记忆，进入一个被数据监控的未来。
works.idea_en: Becoming a spirit through body replacement: without a body you see how a regime, then and now, reduces people to measurable data.
works.idea_zh: 通过身体替换成为一个灵魂：失去身体之后，你看见政权如何——无论过去还是现在——把人简化为可测量的数据。
works.method: Head-mounted VR with motion controllers and a body-replacement illusion that gives the viewer a floating spectral body; draws on Taiwanese folk religion and the Ghost Festival.
works.method_zh: 头戴式 VR 配合动作控制器，用身体替换错觉赋予观众一具漂浮的灵体；取材于台湾民间信仰与中元节。

paper.title: Towards a Techno-Hauntological Aesthetic: Immiscible Time and the Spiritual Imagination in Bodyless (Shishenji, 2019) by Huang Hsin-Chien

works.title: Ghost Giant
works.description: A VR puzzle game in which the player is a giant ghost, invisible to everyone except a lonely boy named Louis. Looming over a toy-like town, the player lifts roofs, turns houses and moves objects to help him.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 解谜游戏：玩家是一个巨大的幽灵，除了孤独的男孩 Louis 之外谁也看不见他。玩家俯视一座玩具般的小镇，掀开屋顶、转动房子、移动物件来帮助男孩。
works.idea_en: Being a spirit is a matter of scale and invisibility: you can reshape a whole town yet reach only the one person who can see you.
works.idea_zh: 成为幽灵关乎尺度与隐形：你能改变整座小镇，却只能触及那唯一看得见你的人。
works.method: Room-scale VR on PlayStation VR (Move controllers) and Oculus Quest, with the world built at miniature scale around the seated or standing player.
works.method_zh: 在 PlayStation VR（Move 控制器）和 Oculus Quest 上运行的房间尺度 VR，世界以微缩比例搭建在坐着或站着的玩家周围。

works.title: NariTan
works.description: An immersive VR vocabulary-learning system in which the learner embodies a dragon and acts out English words through the dragon's body. A study found fewer words forgotten after one week than with conventional study.
works.description_zh: 一个沉浸式 VR 词汇学习系统：学习者化身为一条龙，用龙的身体演示英语单词。研究发现，与常规学习相比，一周后遗忘的单词更少。
works.idea_en: A non-human body as a memory aid: words are learned through the actions of a dragon body the learner has never had.
works.idea_zh: 把非人类身体当作记忆的辅助：通过一具学习者从未拥有过的龙之身体的动作来学单词。
works.method: Head-mounted display with a full-body dragon avatar driven by the learner's movements; retention, workload and emotion were compared with traditional study, also varying the number of avatars.
works.method_zh: 头显配合由学习者动作驱动的全身龙化身；比较了与传统学习相比的记忆保持、工作负荷与情绪，并改变化身数量进行实验。

paper.title: NariTan: Enhancing Second Language Vocabulary Learning Through Non-Human Avatar Embodiment in Immersive Virtual Reality

leads.name: Texada (Josephine Anderson & Claire Sanford, NFB, IDFA DocLab 2023)
leads.why: VR documentary on limestone and geological time; limestone guides the story but the viewer stays a human observer, so it fails the becoming rule.

leads.name: Thinking like a mountain (Thomas Pellerey Grogan, 2021)
leads.why: VR installation where visitors scrape and stack rocks with hand tracking; the participant handles rock rather than becoming it.

leads.name: Stone (Shinseungback Kimyonghun, 2017) - already in global.json
leads.why: Visitors stand inside 64 solenoids replaying waves hitting a stone on Ulleungdo to 'become the stone'; closest body-augmented rock work, but it carries no scope, so a curator must decide whether it counts as core.

leads.name: Collective Body (Sarah Silverblatt-Buser, Venice 2025) - already in festivals.json
leads.why: Social VR dance that assigns each participant an earth, air, water or fire avatar; the only realised XR 'becoming fire' found. It carries no scope yet.

leads.name: Birdly Jurassic Flight (Somniacs) - already in animals-art.json
leads.why: Prone flight simulator in which you fly as a pterosaur; the only realised XR extinct-species embodiment found. It carries no scope yet.

leads.name: Nakayama et al., paleontological learning system (2014-2015)
leads.why: Kinect system that animates extinct animals in sync with children's movements on a display; screen-based, not immersive XR.

leads.name: The Dream of Zhuang Zhou (Shuai Zou et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Art Papers)
leads.why: Multispecies VR on Zhuangzi's butterfly dream; already in hci-animal.json; belongs to insect/animal fields rather than things.

leads.name: Mixanthropy: Holographic Metamorphic Clouds (Meichun Cai & Yiou Wang, ACM MM 2025)
leads.why: Holographic installation with chimeras that morph in response to the viewer; the viewer watches rather than embodies.

leads.name: Bidirectional Infection Experiences in a Virtual Environment (Tani et al., IEEE VR 2019)
leads.why: VR with haptic vest that visualises pathogen droplets; the user stays human (infected or infecting), not the virus.
